faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore Research Associate (RA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Associate (RA) position at IIT Indore is 22nd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D/MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree. Alternatively, 03 years of research, teaching, and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one SCI journal publication is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate (RA) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate (RA) position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate (RA) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate (RA) position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 58,000/- to Rs. 67,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Indore Research Associate (RA) vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate (RA) position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate (RA) post at IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Research Associate (RA) position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Indore located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Indore is located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 453552.
